cards.title: Capas transparentes de información sobre una mesa de trabajo
cards.description: Consistent AgntiaPro art direction: warm editorial European design magazine, ivory #fcfaf6, ink #242421, subtle violet #6550dd and champagne gold #b49665 only as accents, beautiful natural materials, refined realism, quiet cinematic light, generous negative space, excellent photographic composition. No readable text, letters, logos, branding, UI, watermarks, neon, futuristic dashboards, stock-photo clichés. Translucent glass sheets hovering subtly above neatly arranged handwritten paper notes, a pencil and a ceramic cup, quiet augmented cognition made tangible, warm cream daylight, a single restrained violet detail, precise cinematic editorial photography.
